sourceDescription: 白室决斗，本地母稿，未作为发布依赖
name: 白垩剧场
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: supplied White Chamber Duel BladeTrace game screen. Create ONE landscape 2D game concept variant. Retain WHITE CHAMBER identity: monumental pale architectural planes, asymmetric charcoal slab on left, small vertical red doorway upper right of center, masked black long-coat swordsman at upper center and white-shirt black-trouser player lower center. Keep relative composition and poses, no fencing-suit redesign. Broad clean negative-space battlefield between them, a single curved dark blade trajectory, red enemy dot and teal player dot near player, small solid hurtbox and larger dashed parry circle concentric at player; rings circular screen-space overlays. Remove huge decorative floor circle. Preserve compact English HUD: BLADETRACE, POSTURE 62%, PHASE II, HP 80/100, STRIKE, RESET, EDIT. This is a genuinely hand-designed 2D game screen, not realistic 3D rendering with a texture filter. No realistic reflections, material bump, ambient occlusion or physically simulated lighting. Architectural depth suggested only by overlapping flat graphic planes. Functional dots, trajectory and circles crisp and unobscured. No ink-wash/calligraphy, Asian traditional motifs, neon, ornate fantasy or cartoon cuteness. Modern, austere, premium. Material direction A: opaque architectural gouache illustration, warm chalk-white and charcoal matte paint, subtle dry pigment brush texture visible ONLY in large perimeter wall shapes and clothing. Characters painted as clean bold 2D silhouettes with 2 to 3 opaque tone blocks, hand-cut crisp edges. The sweeping diagonal shadow on left becomes a pale flat grey graphic wedge, without obscuring central gameplay. No paper aging, no watery washes. A refined hand-painted animation background with flat hand-painted character sprites; human touch, quiet museum-like white chamber. Central field almost untextured.
